text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 6, 2023) for 19 Branch Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed Items 1 and 2, and 4 to 6 of the Property Standards Order (September 6, 2023) for 19 Branch Avenue, Folder Number 23 195307 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension of time to April 1, 2024. 2. Confirmed Item 3 of the Property Standards Order (September 6, 2023) for 19 Branch Avenue, Folder Number 23 195307 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension of time to December 2, 2024.
